newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys Nov 0.5-pct fuel oil around $138/tn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys Nov 0.5-pct fuel oil around $138/tn.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) purchased by tender a 38,000-tonne cargo of low sulphur fuel oil at around $138 per tonne for delivery in November, a CPC source said on Thursday.
The cargo of 0.5-percent sulphur fuel oil will be delivered to Keelung or Shen Ao between November 1 and 10, on cost-and-freight basis, he said.
The tender closed September 18 and was valid until September 20.
In its last tender, CPC bought two 38,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5-percent sulphur fuel oil at $129.50 per tonne for September 1-20 delivery, c-and-f basis.
